notes.title: Two Hour Escape Mystery: A Puzzling Voyage will release on November 8th!
notes.notes:
[b]Two Hour Escape Mystery: A Puzzling Voyage[/b] is releasing on [b]November 8th[/b]!

A Puzzling Voyage awaits! Prepare to explore a ship full of secrets and extravagant rooms. Ask questions, solve puzzles, and solve a mystery to escape!

[b]A Puzzling Voyage[/b] is the first installment in the [b]Two Hour Escape Mystery[/b] series, with many more settings, puzzles, and mysteries planned for the future. Bon voyage!
